entries.b046b4fdc234adc9: A business that provides, consistently from the formulation of clients' marketing strategies, the handling of advertising media such as newspapers, magazines, radio, television, internet and outdoor advertising, advertising production, consulting, research, sales promotion, public relations and event execution, and that accounts for nearly all of the Group's revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥858,427 million. Business activities are carried out by five core companies, Hakuhodo, Daiko, Yomiko Advertising, Hakuhodo DY ONE and kyu, a strategic business organization, each of which forms a group with its own affiliated companies. There is one reportable segment for the consolidated group as a whole.
entries.c457ba78a7816ce6: Formulation of marketing strategies and various plans; consulting
entries.e17227273d77b684: This is business other than advertising. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,575 million. In the “Status of Affiliated Companies” section, subsidiaries such as Hakuhodo Technologies, Hakuhodo DY Corporate Initiative and Hakuhodo DY Total Support are listed under this category. The filing does not separately describe the contents of this category.
entries.e51227f80e5eba14: An advertising and marketing holding company with Hakuhodo, Daiko, Yomiko Advertising and others under its umbrella, providing integrated marketing.
